extra_fields.subject: Structured user reviews comparing Etsy marketplace to alternatives on Capterra.
extra_fields.sub: searches attempted:** SD-14. Searched for "etsy capterra comparison review."
extra_fields.outcome: Capterra indexes Etsy-adjacent tools (EtsyHunt, EtsyMarketingTool, MyDesigns) but not the Etsy marketplace itself as a reviewable product. Individual tool reviews mention Etsy fees tangentially but do not constitute marketplace-level competitive comparisons.
extra_fields.reason_for_failure: Product not indexed on this review aggregator.
